title: Head of Strategy Delivery
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Reporting to the Country Director, the Head of Strategy & Planning serves as a trusted strategic adviser and execution partner to the Country Director. The role leads the development, implementation, monitoring, and periodic review of the Ethiopia Country Program’s strategy and annual operating plans. It drives organizational performance, strategic alignment, cross-functional coordination, and operational rigour to enhance the quality and impact of programming.

The role supports the Country Director in setting and managing leadership priorities, facilitating effective decision-making, coordinating the Country Leadership Team, and ensuring timely execution of critical decisions and strategic initiatives. The position also leads high-priority, cross-functional, and transformational projects while strengthening information flow, organizational accountability, and follow-through across the Country Program.

WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE

Strategy and Planning

  • Lead the development, review, and implementation of the Ethiopia Country Program strategy; translate it into annual operating plans, priorities, targets, measurable outcomes, and short-, medium-, and long-term roadmaps.
  • Coordinate planning across functions and align programmatic, operational, financial, and people priorities.
  • Provide strategic analysis, research, scenarios, and recommendations; monitor the external environment and assess implications for the Country Program.

Strategy Execution and Performance Management

  • Establish and manage a framework for monitoring strategic priorities, Country Program performance, key results, and quarterly performance reviews.
  • Track leadership decisions and strategic initiatives, escalate risks and delays, prepare concise reports, dashboards, and decision papers, and facilitate corrective action where performance is below target.

Chief of Staff Support

  • Serve as a trusted adviser and thought partner to the Country Director; help establish leadership priorities and manage the flow, prioritization, delegation, and escalation of strategic information and decisions.
  • Prepare the Country Director for critical engagements; attend selected meetings with or on behalf of the Country Director; and ensure decisions and actions are documented and implemented.

Leadership Governance and Coordination

  • Coordinate the Country Leadership Team’s annual agenda, meetings, retreats, and strategic discussions, with a clear focus on decisions, priorities, performance, risks, and accountability.
  • Maintain a consolidated record of leadership decisions, commitments, and actions; identify organizational bottlenecks; and strengthen communication and coordination across the Country Program.

Strategic Initiatives and Transformation

  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional, and transformational initiatives by establishing clear objectives, governance, milestones, resources, reporting mechanisms, and risk-mitigation actions.
  • Ensure strategic projects achieve intended results within agreed timelines, while promoting innovation, organizational learning, and effective change management.

Program Quality and Organizational Effectiveness

  • Support leadership oversight of program quality, impact, and strategic alignment; facilitate portfolio reviews; identify systemic delivery challenges; and escalate major risks, interdependencies, and resource constraints for resolution.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A master’s degree in International Development, Public Policy, Economics, or another relevant field is preferred.
  • Professional certification in strategy, project or programme management, change management, performance management, or organizational development is an added advantage; continuous professional development in strategic leadership, executive advisory, or organizational performance is desirable.
  • Minimum of 12 years of progressively responsible professional experience, including at least five years in a senior strategy, planning, management consulting, programme leadership, executive advisory, or general management role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading strategy development, annual planning, execution, performance reviews, and the translation of strategy into practical priorities, indicators, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Experience serving as a strategic adviser or thought partner to a Chief Executive, Country Director, senior executive, or leadership team.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, high-profile, cross-functional initiatives from conception through implementation and evaluation.
  • Experience coordinating leadership forums, management reviews, strategic retreats, and executive decision-making processes, and producing high-quality briefings, analyses, business cases, presentations, reports, and decision papers.
  • Strong experience in stakeholder engagement, organizational performance monitoring, financial planning, budgeting, resource allocation, risk management, and corrective action.
  • Experience working in complex, multicultural, and matrixed organizations, preferably within international development, philanthropy, the public sector, consulting, or another mission-driven organization.
  • Significant knowledge of Ethiopia’s development context, with broader exposure to social and economic development issues in Africa, is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrates strategic thinking and systems analysis, strategy development and planning, strategy execution and performance management, data analysis and management reporting, executive advisory and decision support, programme, project, and governance management, financial, operational, and risk management, and strategic communication and stakeholder influence.
  • Demonstrates strategic leadership and results orientation, sound judgment, adaptability, and problem-solving, influence, collaboration, and clear communication, inclusive people leadership and teamwork, and integrity, discretion, fairness, respect, humility, and responsible leadership.
  • Strong commitment to Mastercard Foundation’s values and vision.

The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone.


Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment.

For more information and to sign up for the Foundation’s newsletter, please visit http://www.mastercardfdn.org/
Follow the Foundation on Twitter at @MastercardFdn

title: Account Coordinator-Temp

Ever wondered what it takes to build one of the largest and most respected healthcare staffing and total talent solutions companies? It takes trailblazers, innovators, and exceptional people like you.

  • Prepare and distribute reports, maintain databases, and support administrative functions as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with department policies, procedures, and client expectations.

Key Skills


  • Strong Organization: You’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable keeping track of multiple moving pieces.
  • Time Management: You know how to prioritize competing needs, meet deadlines, and adjust quickly when priorities change.
  • Customer Focus: You’re a strong communicator who enjoys building relationships and providing responsive, dependable support.
  • Adaptability: You’re a quick learner who can confidently navigate new systems, processes, and changing business needs.
  • Collaboration: You enjoy working across teams and understand the importance of keeping everyone informed and aligned.
  • Attention to Detail: You take ownership of your work and understand that accuracy matters throughout the hiring process.



Qualifications


Education & Years of Experience

  • High School Diploma/GED plus 2-5 years of work experience in supporting recruiting, staffing, account management, client services, vendor management, or a similar fast-paced environment.
  • Experience coordinating hiring, candidate submissions, supplier relationships, or administrative workflows is beneficial.
  • Demonstrate the ability to effectively use technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, support decision-making, and enhance business outcomes while adhering to company policies and responsible AI practices.

Additional Experience

  • Experience with Fieldglass or similar vendor management systems is a plus, but not required.

Work Environment / Physical Requirements


  • Work is performed in an office/home office environment.
  • Team Members must have the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards.

AMN Healthcare will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the job.




Our Core Values

title: Hearing Representative (Southern California)
description:
Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this job is to serve as a litigation representative to attend hearings, depositions, and resolve disputes as it applies to aspects of workers’ compensation claims. This position exists to reduce allocated loss adjustment expenses and improve results by proactively analyzing and resolving workers’ compensation claims.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Manages litigation and claim disputes as they apply to workers’ compensation claims.

  • Attends claim hearings representing ICW Group.

  • Appears at WCAB lien conferences and trials; may need to appear at status, priority, and mandatory settlement conferences on occasion.

  • Schedules and attends settlement walk-through hearings with claimants and/or counsel.

  • Reduces loss adjustment expenses by quickly and effectively resolving disputed claims and litigation, including liens.

  • Resolves claims fairly and equitably, acting in the best interest of the insured.

Prepares documentation necessary for assigned cases.

  • Prepares court pleadings, reports, and settlement documents in accordance with statutory and case law as well as pertinent regulations.

  • Prepares for and attends depositions; maintains notes and correspondence.

  • Prepares and submits timely Hearing Reports to claims personnel and claims management.

  • Reviews and analyzes the billed invoices and liens and compares with professional bill review analysis.

Provides subject matter expertise in the litigation aspect of workers’ compensation claims.

  • Applies appropriate legal defenses and negotiates resolution or set for trial.

  • Provides guidance and expertise to other department’s operations, including Underwriting and Risk Management Services.

  • Partners with Claims Examiner to determine solutions.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university in Business Administration, Management or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 2-5 years of experience in workers' compensation required, with claims examiner experience preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None required.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Working knowledge of claims and insurance industry preferred. Familiarity with and ability to effectively utilize the CA Labor Code, CA Code of Regulations, and CA Schedule for Rating Permanent Disabilities to rate disability impairment. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical journals, financial reports, and/or legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from counsel, claimants, customers, regulatory agencies, and/or members of the business community. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors. Strong ability to negotiate to resolution various legal issues before the WCAB with opposing counsel, proper claimants, and co-defendants. Strong oral skills to articulate company’s position in contested legal matters to opposing side, Information Officers, and WCAB judges.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position requires some travel – up to 20 hours per week. Works with computers and computer screens for multiple hours per day; must be able to lift and carry 25-40 pounds. Position is sedentary approximately 80% of time. Must be able to drive and be comfortable working independently.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position is a hybrid field/office position. Field environment includes appearing at various WCAB district offices, driving to and from appointments/appearances, meeting with attorneys/judges, and use of cell phone/email. Office environment includes use of a computer, telephone, copier and other standard office equipment.

We are currently not offering employment sponsorship for this opportunity

title: Financial Planning Specialist II

Ultium Cells Overview:

Ultium Cells, LLC. is a joint venture Lithium-ion automotive battery cell manufacturing plant between LG Energy Solution, Ltd., and General Motors. This high-technology plant is a new construction that has the latest in battery cell manufacturing technology. This $2.3 billion investment is among the largest battery cell manufacturing plants in the world. Ultium Cells produces battery cells for General Motors’ North American electric vehicle applications.

Ultium Cells’ partners include LG Energy Solution, Ltd.; the world’s largest manufacturer of automotive battery cells, and General Motors; a global company committed to delivering safer, better and more sustainable ways for people to get around.


Job Description:

Ultium Cells seeks a Financial Specialist who is responsible for collecting and studying the financial and operational data to analyze profitability of the business, extracting and defining relevant information. The candidate will dig into complex datasets to analyze trends and translate them into actionable insights for continuous process/profitability improvements. This role also will be able to communicate with cross-functional teams and individuals within the company.

• • Break-work-in-silo mentality

title: Quality Supervisor Night Shift
description:
Ultium Cells Overview:

Ultium Cells is a joint venture lithium-Ion automotive battery cell manufacturing plant between LG Energy Solutions and General Motors. This new construction high-technology plant will have the latest battery cell manufacturing technology. The investment in this new business venture represents a commitment of more than $2.3 Billion. It will be among the largest battery cell manufacturing plants in the world. Ultium Cells will produce battery cells for General Motors North American electric vehicle applications.

The Ultium cell partners include LG Energy Solutions; the world’s largest manufacturer of automotive battery cells in the world and General Motors a global company committed to delivering safer, better and more sustainable ways for people to get around.

This is an onsite, night shift position.

Job Summary:

Ultium Cells is currently seeking a motivated and accomplished battery manufacturing Quality Supervisor who will lead a group of quality laboratory areas within our manufacturing facility. The Quality Supervisor is responsible for safely inspecting and qualifying battery cells manufactured on our assembly lines. We manufacture the highest quality battery cells and the Quality Supervisor will execute and be accountable for all quality lab related activities in their assigned areas. This position will be responsible for analyzing components to meet the established standards of quality including reliability, usability, and performance, while ensuring high yield in a highly automated manufacturing environment. The Quality Supervisor’s functions will also include verification of the product meeting quality standards in accordance with the requirements of the organization. The Quality Supervisor must be able to communicate effectively within all levels of the organization (multi-functional teams) to discuss and resolve quality issues in a timely manner. The Quality Supervisor will be responsible to understand upstream and downstream processes, to work with other peer leaders as One Ultium Team, and to ensure efficient operation of the business to support customer demand. Position requires 12-hr off shift work (nights) on a crew schedule and some on-call support or coverage as business dictates.

The Quality Supervisor has responsibility for 7-18 hourly inspectors engaged in battery cell inspection activities. The position involves a considerable amount of initiative and proactive initiative. Strong people skills are required in this position, working in a joint venture and union environment, supporting the requirements of Ultium’s customers and parent companies, and in building a unique and inclusive Ultium culture. Ensuring the Ultium team has strong collaborative relationships is critical.

The Quality Supervisor will also be expected to possess technical skills at an inspector level, understand how to run testing equipment and to properly interact with the technical resource teams that support quality and production. Technical proficiency, ability to learn quickly, and a drive for continued technical learning as well as self-directed problem-solving is also important in this role.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Manages floor operations for assigned quality labs.
  • Ensure compliance for plant safety and environmental regulations; understands promotes, educates, communicates and follows up on safety processes, deliverables and other initiatives
  • Maintains safety/quality culture through direct interaction with the team, audits/observation and incident investigation, with a proactive mindset.
  • Support Team Members and coordinates the activities of employees engaged in the quality inspection of components.
  • Has a proactive problem-solving mindset, to drive continuous improvement.
  • Understands and supports SPQRCE (Safety, People, Quality, Responsiveness, Cost and Environment) and KPI metrics
  • Responsible for the floor level operations training plan for the quality inspection teams
  • Evaluate operators’ level periodically with validation techniques to improve the inspection level

Torch Technologies is seeking an experienced Enterprise Chief Engineer to serve as the senior technical advisor and architectural authority for enterprise information technology capabilities. The Enterprise Chief Engineer will lead technical vision, engineering standards, architecture governance, integration, and technical risk management across a complex enterprise portfolio.

This role requires a strategic, hands-on technical leader who can ensure delivered systems, applications, networks, cloud environments, and IT services are modern, secure, scalable, resilient, and architecturally coherent. The successful candidate will work closely with enterprise IT leadership, program managers, section chiefs, mission partners, developers, network operations teams, cybersecurity personnel, and system owners to align technical delivery with long-term mission objectives.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, and Technical Integration

- Serve as the Enterprise Chief Engineer and principal technical advisor for enterprise engineering standards, architecture, integration, and technical risk.

- Develop and maintain three- to five-year technical modernization roadmaps and architecture-evolution plans aligned to enterprise mission objectives, growth requirements, and technology priorities.

- Establish, maintain, and enforce enterprise engineering standards, architectural principles, design patterns, and technical baselines.

- Chair or lead Engineering Review Boards (ERBs), design reviews, and technical governance forums.

- Review, assess, and adjudicate proposed architectures, technical designs, engineering approaches, and major technology changes.

- Ensure systems, networks, applications, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise services comply with approved architecture principles, cybersecurity requirements, interoperability needs, and engineering standards.

- Translate emerging science and engineering mission requirements and operational needs into viable, secure, scalable, and sustainable technical solutions.

- Lead enterprise-level configuration control activities, including management of architectural baselines, technical dependencies, and change-control processes.

- Serve as the final technical authority for complex engineering decisions, technical disputes, integration challenges, and multi-disciplinary design tradeoffs.

- Identify, assess, track, and mitigate enterprise technical risks, vulnerabilities, dependencies, capacity constraints, and architectural single points of failure.

- Provide technical direction to improve system resiliency, availability, maintainability, performance, and lifecycle sustainability.

Strategic Engineering Operations and Mission Integration

- Provide enterprise leadership, section chiefs, program managers, and mission partners with strategic technical advice, architectural analysis, technology forecasting, and capacity-planning recommendations.

- Deliver executive-level technical briefings, architectural health assessments, readiness analyses, and data-driven risk reports.

- Guide engineering teams in applying agile methods and enterprise tools to deliver architectural changes securely, efficiently, and with minimal operational friction.

- Monitor the technical health of the enterprise portfolio and recommend investments, modernization priorities, and corrective actions.

- Promote a culture of disciplined engineering, technical rigor, innovation, documentation, and continuous improvement.

- Support planning, prioritization, and sequencing of enterprise engineering initiatives to balance mission needs, technical debt, cybersecurity requirements, resources, and operational constraints.

  • Extensive experience leading enterprise architecture, systems engineering, technical integration, or engineering governance activities within complex IT environments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing enterprise technology roadmaps, reference architectures, engineering standards, and modernization strategies.
  • Experience leading architecture review boards, design reviews, configuration-control processes, or comparable technical governance forums.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, federal, defense, intelligence, research and development, or other mission-critical enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud, zero trust, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, containerization, platform engineering, data platforms, or enterprise service management.

Torch Technologies

Torch Technologies is seeking a Cybersecurity Journeyman (ISSO) to join the Transportation Systems Family: Cargo Movement Operations System (CMOS), Online Vehicle Interactive Management System (OLVIMS), Movement Automated Record Keeping System (MARKS). CMOS is a joint use program. Air Force, Army, Navy, Marine Corps, National Security Agency, and Defense Contract Management Agency transportation activities use CMOS to automate and streamline base level cargo movement processes and support rapid movement of military assets worldwide. CMOS is a DoW directed program which addresses critical shortfalls in moving cargo and people in support of the DoW mission. CMOS automates and streamlines base-level cargo movement processes in peacetime as well as cargo and passenger movements during contingencies. OLVIMS Dispatch is utilized by Vehicle Operations personnel to manage transportation requests, dispatch vehicles and manage driver utilization. MARKS is part of the Headquarters Air Force Logistics, Engineering & Force Protection (AF/A4) portfolio and used to support household good shipments of military members and authorized DoW civilians. title: RF Test Engineer III (Clearance Required)
description:
Sierra Space Careers:

At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.

Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role

As a RF Test Engineer III at Sierra Space, you will leverage your growing experience and working knowledge of test engineering principles to support and contribute to the testing and validation of complex, integrated aerospace systems — including spacecraft, satellites, or other large-scale systems incorporating electrical, mechanical, and software components. You will work under the guidance of senior engineers to help develop and execute test approaches for RF and space communications systems, while building toward greater autonomy in your area of expertise.

About You

Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission.

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the design and execution of RF and space communications tests, including the use of RF antennas, antenna hats, modems, vector network analyzers (VNA), spectrum analyzers, cable analyzers (VSWR), and communications cabling.
  • Implement and execute test scripts and code (e.g., Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB) for control, telemetry, data acquisition, and analysis of integrated systems.
  • Work with Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) — including power supplies, controls, instruments, sensors, networking and communications equipment, data acquisition equipment, and associated software and wiring, including National Instruments & LabVIEW products.
  • Interpret electrical and network schematics and signal channelization databases to support test execution.
  • Contribute to software testing efforts spanning functionality, performance, and regression testing.
  • Support execution of tests on integrated systems for thermal vacuum (TVAC), vibration, shock, acoustic, EMI/EMC, and other space environments, using a variety of instrumentation and sensors to measure electrical, mechanical, optical, and other characteristics.
  • Prepare test procedures and test reports, and support development of test plans, to demonstrate compliance with system requirements.
  • Apply familiarity with Product and Quality Assurance principles to support the generation and disposition of product non-conformances.
  • Read and interpret schematics, use service manuals, follow test procedures, and apply logical troubleshooting techniques to resolve testing issues.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to team members, senior engineers, and stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and successful project outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications:


  • Requires Bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree or Masters +3 yrs experience).
  • Typically 5+ years of related experience.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S. Security Clearance is required.
  • General expertise in one area of test engineering principles and practices (dynamics, thermal, measurement, HSI, SW Test, Integration, etc.).
  • Ability to effectively work in multi-disciplinary design and development teams.
  • Experience with requirements management, system design, and systems integration.
  • Experience planning, conducting, and documenting Verification and Validation (V&V) activities.
  • Ability to read/interpret schematics, use service manuals, follow test procedures, and use logical troubleshooting techniques.
  • General expertise with various testing equipment, standards, and methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Skilled in test design and execution of integrated products or systems, including spacecraft, aircraft, ships, or other similar large and complex systems that incorporate electrical, mechanical, and software components, typically working under the guidance of senior engineers
  • Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or similar degree, or equivalent experience
  • Experience with programming and using TILE! EMI/EMC testing application
  • Experience implementing and executing test scripts and code (e.g., Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB) for control, telemetry, data acquisition, and analysis of integrated systems
  • Experience supporting or executing RF and space communications tests, including use of RF antennas, antenna hats, modems, vector network analyzers (VNA), spectrum analyzers, cable analyzers (VSWR), and communications cabling
  • Working knowledge of Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) including power supplies, controls, instruments, sensors, networking equipment, communications equipment (including RF signal/network analyzers), data acquisition equipment, and associated software and wiring, including National Instruments & LabVIEW products
  • Ability to interpret electrical and network schematics and signal channelization databases to support test execution
  • Experience with software testing including functionality, performance, and regression testing
  • Experience supporting or executing tests on integrated systems for thermal vacuum (TVAC), vibration, shock, acoustic, EMI/EMC, and other space environments
  • Familiarity with a variety of instrumentation and sensors to measure electrical, mechanical, optical, etc. characteristics
  • Ability to prepare test procedures and test reports, and support development of test plans, to demonstrate compliance to system requirements
  • General familiarity with Product and Quality Assurance principles, including supporting generation and disposition of product non-conformances
  • Exposure to or support of certification testing for various certification organizations (i.e., FAA, NASA, DoD) preferred
  • Ability to read schematics, use service manuals, follow test procedures, and apply logical troubleshooting techniques
  • Background in the Aerospace and Defense Industry preferred

Compensation:

Pay Range:

$112,694.00 - $154,975.25

Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness.

IMPORTANT NOTICE:

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.

Elevate Your Career

At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations.


We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more.

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. This Sr Solution Consultant provides consultative sales support for AspenTech's geological modelling software. You will need to understand customer challenges and industry drivers, support the development of a vision and roadmap of a solution that addresses customer requirements, build and justify business cases to secure client investment, and provide support to the direct sales force in the sales process.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor Degree in Petroleum Geoscience/Engineering or equivalent with at least 8 years of experience in upstream geological modelling software, preferably with a national oil company or equivalent.
  • Proven experience in using Aspen RMS and/or Aspen SKUA software
  • Strong collaboration skills
  • Ability to develop and implement workflows and best practices for geological modelling.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, and advancements in geological modelling techniques and software.
  • Strong drive to solve customer problems, and swiftly convert pipeline opportunities into closed deals.
  • Intellectual curiosity, grit, resilience and good balance of business and technology acumen.
  • Enjoys customer facing with good experience in presenting and does consultative selling.

title: Senior Project Manager of Reroofing
description:
About O’Hara’s Son Roofing Company

Since 1987, O’Hara’s Son Roofing (OSR) has provided new commercial roof construction, commercial roof replacement, commercial leak repair service, and preventative maintenance for commercial roofs. Headquartered in Chicago, IL, our team of 100+ employees is dedicated to providing quality work with a strong focus on safety and communication.

As of 2026, OSR ranks among the Top 20 Roofing Contractors in the country. We specialize in the installation of numerous styles of roof applications and coatings. Additionally, we provide extensive roof repairs, OSHA-compliant safety items, and renewable energy solutions.

OSR maintains branches throughout the country, providing timely service and maintenance to our partners in each region of the United States.

Join Our Dynamic Team and Embrace Our Core Values!

At O’Hara’s Son Roofing (OSR), we believe in “Putting the Pedal to the Metal,” driving our success forward by continuously improving and never settling for average work. As a family-oriented company, we embrace a "No Jerk Zone," fostering an environment of respect, support, and teamwork at every level. We value self-starters who take pride in their work, go above and beyond for the team, and seize opportunities to shape their future with us. If you share our commitment to doing all the little things well and being our customers' preferred roofing contractor, we invite you to apply.

Job Description

As a Senior Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing retail reroofing projects from initiation to completion. We are specifically looking for someone with experience managing large national customers with multiple sites. Your expertise in project management, strong leadership skills, and commitment to delivering high-quality results will ensure the successful execution of projects while meeting client expectations and maintaining exceptional customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Planning and Execution:

  • Lead and manage multiple retail reroofing projects simultaneously, ensuring adherence to project plans, budgets, and timelines.

  • Collaborate with the sales team and clients during the pre-construction phase to assess project requirements, conduct site evaluations, and provide accurate cost estimates.

  • Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope of work, schedules, budgets, and resource allocation.

  • Coordinate and collaborate with subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure efficient project execution.

  • Monitor project progress, proactively identify and address any issues or challenges, and implement corrective measures as necessary.

  • Conduct regular site visits and inspections to ensure quality control, adherence to safety protocols, and compliance with project specifications.

  1. Client Relationship Management:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle, maintaining regular communication and providing updates on project progress.

  • Cultivate strong relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction and addressing any concerns or issues promptly.

  • Collaborate with the sales team to identify opportunities for additional services and upselling during the project.

  1. Team Leadership and Management:

  • Lead and manage a team of project managers, estimators, field staff, and subcontractors, providing guidance, support, and mentorship.

  • Set clear expectations and performance goals for the project team, conducting regular performance evaluations and providing constructive feedback.

  • Foster a collaborative and cohesive work environment, promoting teamwork, communication, and accountability.

  • Facilitate effective communication and coordination between different project stakeholders, ensuring smooth project workflow.

  1. Financial Management:

  • Develop and manage project budgets, closely monitoring project costs and expenses to ensure profitability.

  • Review and approve project-related invoices, purchase orders, and change orders in accordance with established processes.

  • Collaborate with the finance team to ensure accurate and timely invoicing, payments, and financial reporting.

  • Conduct regular financial analysis and reporting, providing updates on project financial performance to senior management.

  1. Quality Control and Safety:

  • Ensure adherence to quality control measures and industry standards throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Conduct regular inspections to ensure workmanship and materials meet project specifications and quality requirements.

  • Collaborate with the safety team to implement and enforce safety protocols, promoting a culture of safety on all project sites.

  • Address any quality or safety concerns promptly, taking appropriate actions to resolve issues.

  1. Additional Responsibilities:

  • Handle additional responsibilities and projects as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in commercial roofing, with a focus on retail reroofing projects.

  • Experience managing large national customers with multiple sites.

  • Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering retail reroofing projects on time and within budget.

  • Strong knowledge of roofing systems, materials, and installation techniques.

  • Proficiency in project management software and tools.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Team player attitude is a must.

  • Ability to effectively collaborate with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams.

  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

  • Knowledge of safety regulations and quality control processes.

  • Ability to climb a 40-foot ladder and lift heavy objects.

  • Willingness to travel as required.

  • Must have a valid driver’s license and clean driving record.

  • OSHA certification or willingness to complete certification.

If you embody our core values of continuous improvement, teamwork, attention to detail, and dedication to delivering consistent, quality work, we invite you to join our team at O’Hara’s Son Roofing (OSR). Together, let's strive for excellence and be the preferred roofing contractor for our valued customers.

title: Financial Data Specialist
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a Financial Data Specialist to join our team in Durham, NC!


Work Schedule: Monday – Friday; 8:00am-5:00pm EST


This hybrid position offers a balanced schedule of three in-office workdays at our Durham, NC location and two remote workdays per week, supporting both collaboration and flexibility.

As a Financial Data Specialist, you will be the guardian of financial master data across Oracle Fusion Cloud and legacy systems. Daily, you will perform a high volume of data entry receiving requests from different parts of the business and going into Oracle and making those configurations. You will also respond to questions from different stakeholders related to data management and performing troubleshooting to resolve issues. Utilize Microsoft Excel for datasets of master data performing analysis.

Your work ensures data integrity, consistency, and accuracy, enabling seamless financial operations and informed business decisions. This role offers the chance to collaborate with cross-functional teams, optimize data processes, and contribute to global system enhancements. No deep technical background is required— just strong attention to detail, solid organizational skills, and a willingness to learn our systems.

Core Responsibilities:
Chart of Accounts (COA) Maintenance

  • Support updates and maintenance of COA structures in Oracle Fusion Cloud. Assist in validating COA changes against financial reporting requirements. Participate in testing and validation of COA updates during system upgrades and patch deployments.

Customer Data Management

  • Process and validate customer data updates in Oracle Fusion Cloud. Ensure timely and accurate entry of customer records, hierarchies, and attributes. Collaborate with business units to resolve data discrepancies and ensure alignment with business rules.

Legacy System Support

  • Maintain master data in legacy ERP systems. Ensure accurate mapping between legacy systems and Oracle Fusion Cloud. Participate in data migration and reconciliation efforts during system upgrades or transitions

Data Quality & Governance

  • Perform regular audits to identify and correct data quality issues. Support data governance initiatives and adhere to data management policies. Document data processes and contribute to continuous process improvement efforts.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, finance, or information Systems with 1+ years’ experience in ERP system data management

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud
  • 2+ years experience with data mapping and reconciliation
  • 2+ year experience with Chart of Accounts (COA)
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel

Additional Job Standards

  • Basic understanding of financial structures
  • Knowledge of legacy ERP systems (Hyperion HFM, Peoplesoft)
  • Experience with data analysis and reporting tools
  • Exposure to data governance frameworks
  • Experience with data analysis and reporting tools
  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills

title: Analysis Specialist
description:
Position Overview

Bertrandt is seeking an experienced Analysis Specialist to support vehicle validation and launch readiness activities within an automotive manufacturing environment. This role is responsible for performing dynamic and static vehicle evaluations during pre-series and series production phases, identifying functional, geometric, squeak and rattle (S&R), and customer-relevant quality concerns.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, a background in automotive vehicle systems, and the ability to document findings and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Vehicle Evaluation & Validation

  • Perform Broad Validation activities according to established customer checklists and standards.
  • Conduct Launch Readiness evaluations and document identified issues.
  • Perform dynamic and static vehicle assessments utilizing Voice of Customer (VOC) criteria.
  • Execute functional and geometric analysis of vehicle systems and components.
  • Conduct comfort analyses for both interior and exterior vehicle systems.

Testing & Diagnostics

  • Operate durability testing equipment including:
    • Robots
    • Climate chambers
    • Control units
    • Shaker test benches
    • Pneumatic and hydraulic systems
  • Evaluate launch vehicles on test tracks and four-post shaker systems to identify customer-relevant squeak and rattle concerns.
  • Perform initial root cause investigations using mechanical and electromechanical troubleshooting techniques.
  • Inspect vehicles for water leaks and determine the source of water ingress utilizing diagnostic tools and analytical methods.

Analysis & Reporting

  • Generate detailed analysis reports documenting findings, concerns, and recommendations.
  • Document issues within appropriate reporting systems and communicate findings to responsible specialists.
  • Validate containment actions and corrective solutions related to noise, vibration, squeak, and rattle concerns.
  • Provide weekly SARTO status reports and issue summaries to management.
  • Review and validate engineering analysis work submitted by process partners.

Engineering Change Management

  • Review Engineering Change Process (ECP) requests.
  • Complete ECP checklists and evaluate change impacts.
  • Research engineering changes and collaborate with cross-functional partners to determine implementation scope.
  • Communicate findings and changes to responsible engineering specialists.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

title: Head of Cloud
location: Milan, Metropolitan City of Milan, Italy
description:
MotorK sits at the intersection of deep vertical complexity - automotive SaaS, 10,000+ dealerships, enterprise-grade requirements - and a company that has gone all-in on AI as its primary engine of scale. We believe vertical SaaS captures the most value from AI, and none of that value is reachable unless the data underneath it is modeled, governed and engineered right.

The Head of Cloud will lead the evolution of MotorK's cloud infrastructure environment to a state of the art AI driven platform engineering team.

We're seeking candidates who bring:

  • Leadership Excellence: A proven history of guiding teams and projects to success.
  • Technical Proficiency: A strong understanding of modern technologies and the ability to adapt quickly.
  • AWS & Kubernetes Mastery: Hands-on experience with these platforms, enabling you to build and manage complex systems.
  • All In on AI: We are extreme on AI adoption, we do everything with AI, cloud infra is no difference

This role offers the opportunity and autonomy to make decisions in the cloud and infrastructure domain for the leading SaaS company in the European automotive industry and to guide your colleagues in software development to adopt best practices in CI/CD, SRE, and infra maintenance.

Requirements

  • Extensive experience (minimum of 8 years) working in a live production cloud infrastructure is essential. Experience in environments serving thousands of clients with SLA commitments is highly advantageous.
  • Proven experience in production-critical environments with SRE framework adoptions is necessary. You will be expected to develop/build the observability platform and lead the implementation of a mature SRE framework across company products and development teams, ensuring SLO/SLA for our customers.
  • Obsessed on AI. Everything should be AI First / AI driven / Done with AI
  • Good Knowledge of Cloud Services, Cloud Architecture, Cloud Governance & Cost Control experience is essential, as MotorK is a cloud-native environment.
  • Solid understanding of:
    - Infrastructure as a code at scale.
    - AWS Governance Experience, with a focus on Security & Networking.
    - FinOps and Cost Controlling.
    - Disaster recovery and business continuity in cloud environments.
  • Solid experience in CI/CD tools and frameworks and DevOps adoption as you are required to evolve the CI/CD platform and help other teams in adopting best practices in continuous deployment.
  • This is a leadership position. You will lead your team and champion the use of best practices throughout MotorK's Tech organization. Prior experience in team management and the ability to communicate effectively in senior management settings are essential for this role.

Benefits

  • Salary from €85,000/year with the final offer adjusted based on experience and skill set.
  • Meal vouchers
  • 26 days holiday + national holidays
  • 30 days a year to work from wherever you want
  • A flexible hybrid setup
  • Genuine room to grow - nationally and internationally. We move fast, and so do careers here.
